name: Charity
overview: Scripture commands believers to show charity by generously giving to those in need without hesitation or hard-heartedness, as seen in Deuteronomy 15:7 and Matthew 5:42. This giving is not only an act of kindness but a spiritual investment, with Proverbs 19:17 affirming that lending to the poor is lending to the Lord Himself. The Bible also warns against ignoring the cries of the needy (Proverbs 21:13) and exhorts believers to give discreetly, seeking the reward from God rather than human praise (Matthew 6:1). Moreover, Luke 6:38 promises abundant blessings in return for generous giving, emphasizing the reciprocal nature of charity under God's providence.
